description_en: Queries the source topics that are subscribed to by a specified custom topic
description_zh: 查询指定自定义Topic订阅的源Topic，即反向路由表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-topic-reverse-route-table --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --topic /x7aWKW9000/testDataToDataHub/user/update --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryTopicReverseRouteTable

parameters.description_en:
